audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Power-integral estimates discard logarithmic and bounded regimes used in the core envelope proof; Unnormalized uniqueness of the ellipsoid with prescribed quadratic blow-down; General blow-down lemma omits the zero solution
limitations: M25-0003-F01 — Power-integral estimates discard logarithmic and bounded regimes used in the core envelope proof — Counterevidence: A complete repair is proved: choose delta=1/4, retain the constant first moment and linear term, and compare integrands before integration. This restores V_C>=-C(1+|x|) and the paraboloid envelope. The main classification is not disproved.

M25-0003-F02 — Unnormalized uniqueness of the ellipsoid with prescribed quadratic blow-down — Counterevidence: The core construction requires existence of one choice and deliberately varies gamma; absolute uniqueness is unnecessary. Add a scale normalization or remove the uniqueness word.

M25-0003-F03 — General blow-down lemma omits the zero solution — Counterevidence: Definition 2.8 excludes the zero solution both geometrically and through its prescribed blow-down. Theorem 1.1 may be read with an implicit nontriviality or degenerate-cylinder convention; that convention should be explicit. No new nontrivial class is shown.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.
